subject.title: Control UI fails to load on Firefox desktop behind reverse proxy — CSP blocks Vite runtime eval(), 'Control UI did not start', WebSocket 1006

question: Should this issue stay open as the live-proof tracker for the Firefox reverse-proxy WebSocket 1006 failure, or should maintainers fold it fully into the existing Control UI CSP/Zod issue?
rationale: The CSP evidence overlaps an open canonical issue, but the undefined connect-timing fields and reverse-proxy-only WebSocket 1006 symptom are not fully explained by that canonical thread without live browser/network proof.

options.title: Keep Separate Pending Live Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open for redacted Firefox network/console and nginx WebSocket proxy proof while linking the CSP half to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362.

options.title: Fold Into CSP Canonical
options.body: Close this only if maintainers decide the CSP/Zod violation is the sole actionable root cause and the WebSocket 1006 symptom should be retested after that fix.

options.title: Fix CSP First, Then Re-Test
options.body: Advance the strict-CSP Zod fix under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362 and require a fresh narrower reverse-proxy report if 1006 persists afterward.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Pending Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for redacted Firefox network/console and nginx WebSocket proxy proof while linking the CSP half to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362.

likelyOwner.reason: The oldest and strongest history trail for Control UI CSP/bootstrap serving and Gateway security boundaries points to steipete.
